description: Read the change log for a building: who changed an apartment, a payment, or an expense.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

entityType.description: Filter to one entity type, e.g. Payment or Expense.

limit.description: Maximum audit rows to return. Defaults to 50.

name: query_audit_history
title: Audit history
